entities.name: global DNA methylation in prefrontal cortex

relationships.subject: acupuncture
relationships.evidence_quote: Acupuncture treatment for 6 months (3 days/week) improved mechanical/cold allodynia and the emotional/cognitive dysfunction caused by left partial sciatic nerve ligation (PSNL)-induced neuropathic pain.

relationships.subject: acupuncture
relationships.object: global DNA methylation in prefrontal cortex
relationships.evidence_quote: AP treatment significantly reversed global DNA methylation in the PFC (P < 0.001; Fig. 4A).

relationships.subject: acupuncture
relationships.evidence_quote: AP treatment significantly decreased the mRNA expression levels in the PFC (Nr4a1, P < 0.001; Rasgrp1, P < 0.01; Rassf1, P < 0.01; Chkb, P < 0.01; Tekt4, P < 0.01; Abcb6, P < 0.01 vs PSNL; Figs. 8C–I).

relationships.subject: Mecp2
relationships.evidence_quote: was significantly increased as a result of the Mecp2 siRNA treatment

relationships.subject: acupuncture
relationships.evidence_quote: The Newman–Keuls post hoc test indicated that DNMT1 and DNMT3a expression levels were significantly higher in the AP group than in the PSNL group

key_findings: Six months of acupuncture relieved PSNL allodynia, anxiety/depression-like behavior and cognitive deficits and restored reduced global PFC DNA methylation.
Mecp2 knockdown in neuronal cells increased Nr4a1, Rasgrp1, Rassf1 and Chkb mRNA, linking Mecp2 to these acupuncture-targeted genes.
